items.title: Wasmtime编译器SSA索引溢出
items.summary_zh: 能提交Wasm模块者可构造含大量SSA值的函数，使Cranelift发布构建中位打包索引溢出，导致内存破坏
items.action_zh: 升级到36.0.19或43.0.0，并限制编译不可信Wasm模块
items.repro_note: 构造含大量SSA值的Wasm函数，在release构建的Cranelift后端编译触发
items.impact_scope: 服务端Wasm运行时，多租户沙箱场景
items.description: Prior to 36.0.19 and 43.0.0, the Cranelift compiler backend bit-packs SSA value indices in a way that can silently overflow in release builds when compiling a sufficiently large or specially crafted Wasm function with many SSA values. The overflow can make Cranelift reference incorrect IR values, causing arbitrary miscompilation, type confusion, and other attacker-controlled effects that may escape the Wasm sandbox on any architecture using the default Cranelift backend.

items.title: Wasmtime aarch64沙箱逃逸
items.summary_zh: 能提交Wasm模块者可在aarch64引擎上构造分支跳转至用户控制偏移，逃逸沙箱后执行任意代码
items.action_zh: 升级至最新Wasmtime，aarch64环境暂停运行不可信Wasm模块
items.repro_note: aarch64引擎下提交构造分支的Wasm模块，控制跳转偏移验证越界
items.impact_scope: aarch64平台Wasm运行时，云与边缘沙箱
items.description: Wasmtime is a runtime for WebAssembly. The branch can then jump to arbitrary other code at a user-controlled offset, allowing a user-controlled Wasm module to escape the sandbox on aarch64 engines using the default Cranelift backend.

items.title: Postiz内部函数可被越权调用
items.title_zh: Postiz内部函数可被越权调用
items.summary_zh: 已登录用户可请求后端在已连接频道上执行任意内部helper函数，越权触达本不应暴露的接口
items.action_zh: 升级至最新Postiz，后端函数调用增加白名单校验
items.repro_note: 登录后调用频道函数执行接口，将函数名替换为内部helper函数
items.impact_scope: 内网SaaS运营平台，需有效账号
items.description: Postiz lets a signed-in user ask the backend to run a function on one of their connected channels. The backend did not restrict which functions can be requested, so a user could call internal helper functions that were never meant to be reachable from the web interface.
